name: anti-ai-writing
description: A Claude skill that edits any piece of writing to remove AI tells. Distributed as a single-plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: anti-ai-writing
plugins.description: Edits any piece of writing to remove AI tells. Strips banned words, banned phrases, and banned structures at the sentence level, plus discourse-level tells (stated takeaways, manufactured closure, atmospheric openers). Adds a strict review mode that returns a verdict instead of a rewrite. Works in English and Spanish.
